title: Prosecution: Alleged constitutional violations underpin VP Sara impeachment case

blocks.text: A House prosecution panel spokesperson on Saturday said the prosecution’s confidence in its impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte stems from “clear evidence of constitutional violations,” not from any assurance of enough votes of senators.
